products.title: The Mikey Lock by Mikey Musumeci

Be The First In Your Gym To Learn This Leg Locking System That Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci Calls “Unstoppable” - The New Innovated Mikey Lock, The Modern Heel Hooking System That Mikey Created Himself

  • This 4-part series shows you all the leg locking system that Mikey has invented, with concepts, finishes, entries, and more!
  • Learn what sets the Mikey Lock apart from the standard heel hook and how you can use this new style to overcome traditional defenses.
  • Mikey has an eight step system that grapplers of all levels can use to simplify and improve their leg locking game.
  • Mikey recently debuted The Mikey Lock at Who’s Number One, and now you can study this move and get on the trend early.
  • Attack from common guards like K guard, knee shield, and reverse de la riva with MIkey’s techniques for entering into the legs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

Attack From Common Guards Like K Guard, Knee Shield, And Reverse De La Riva With MIkey’s Techniques For Entering Into The Legs!


 

What Will You Learn?

Dive into the next generation of heel hooks with black belt world champion Mikey Musumeci’s “Mikey Lock”, shown here for the first time ever. This modified 50/50 heel hook system can help grapplers of all levels attack below the waist and get submissions against traditional defenses using these modern concepts and innovations.

This 4-part series breaks down the Mikey Lock in full, including entries, finishes, counters to their defenses, and more. Even with no leg locking ability coming in, you’ll be able to simplify an attack leg locks with more consistent success and technique than ever, with Mikey’s tips for success from guard.

Enter into the best leg locking positions possible from knee shield, reverse de la riva, and k guard, with options that will let you stay on offense regardless of the top player’s offense. One you are into the legs, secure the best positions with Mikey’s eight steps for submission success and create the strongest breaks possible.

Defend Your Legs And Set Up Genius Back Takes With World Champion Mikey Musumeci’s Latest Berimbolo Series

  • Mikey Musumeci is a multiple-time world champion and the most successful American black belt competitor ever, known for his technical wizardy and back taking skill
  • Mikey shows you how to stay safe and keep your legs out of IBJJF legal holds while setting up great back taking opportunities
  • These are techniques that can be used by anyone, regardless of if your age and flexibility, with Mikey’s technical approach to grappling
  • Defend from straight ankle locks, kneebars, toe holds, and more as Mikey shows you how to use this to get better positions on your opponent


Defend your legs and get to the back with this 8-volume berimbolo back taking instructional series from Mikey Musumeci!

﻿What Will You Learn?


Turn your opponent’s leg lock attacks into your own technical back takes with this 8-volume instructional series from Mikey Musumeci. Stay safe against IBJJF gi legal leg locks and create chances to take the back with step-by-step breakdowns from Mikey.



Mikey Musumeci is the most successful American black belt competitor in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, winning multiple world championships and competing at an elite level his entire career. This is volume four of Mikey’s continuing berimbolo instructional series, teaching every detail of his signature technical system to share his keys to success with the jiu-jitsu world.

 

Check Out Mikey's Top-Tier Berimbolo Tips!

 

 



Work out of kneebars, toe holds, straight ankle locks, and more with MIkey’s keys to staying out of danger and using our opponent’s attacks into our own back takes. Now you can stay safe against these highly effective submissions and work your way systematically into dominant position.

products.title: The Berimbolo System Part 1: The Foundation by Mikey Musumeci
products.body:
3-Time Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci teaches the most comprehensive berimbolo system ever - including winning details never shown before!

  • Get rid of all the myths around the berimbolo - including how grapplers of any age and level can start using this move without being super flexible
  • This 8-volume mega-series goes through all of the movements, moves, counters, and combos you need to know for a total back take attack
  • The berimbolo is one of BJJ’s most notorious back takes, and now you can find out the exact mechanics behind winning fights with it
  • Mikey is the most successful American Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt ever, winning three world championships in the gi with these systems
  • Master positions like the double guard pull, the stack berimbolo, the twister hook, and more


Unlock All The Simplified Secrets of Systematic Berimbolos From Black Belt World Champion Mikey Musumeci - Including How Older, Bigger Grapplers Can Shock Their Opponents With This Attack (No Flexibility Needed)

Check out a free sample:

 

What Will You Learn?

Black belt back taking wizard Mikey Musumeci is back with BJJ Fanatics with the most expansive and complete berimbolo system ever put together. On this 8-volume series, learn all of Mikey’s favorite ways to take the back as he shows you why the berimbolo is a move anyone can use.

Berimbolos are one of BJJ’s most recognizable and notorious moves, and a lot of older, less flexible grapplers think it isn’t for them. Now that can all change. Mikey’s system is made so that it doesn’t take any crazy flexibility or speed, instead using reliable grips and simple body movements to create the attacks you want.

Across these 8-volumes, learn how to cut out all the confusion and get right to the back with this rolling technique. From top, bottom, and even Mikey’s notorious double guard pull, you can lock into this step-by-step method for exposing the back and securing your control of an opponent.

Even against way bigger, stronger fighters, you can have huge success with the berimbolo. Mikey has become notorious for fighting opponents as big as twice his size, and he does it with a deep level of understanding of technique that few can match. Now, you can benefit from his lifetime of study as he pulls back the curtain on his modern style.
